Cognizant and Google Cloud Expand AI Partnership

Cognizant and Google Cloud have expanded their partnership to develop a new artificial intelligence (AI) workforce, utilizing Google's Gemini technology. This initiative involves a group of 18,000 Cognizant staff members.
